newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shangdong Pharm to kick off IPO next week - sources.
newsitem.headline: Shangdong Pharm to kick off IPO next week - sources.

text.p: China state-owned medicine manufacturer Shangdong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co is expected to kick off an initial public offering of 145 million H-shares next week to raise about HK$300 million, market sources said.
The H-shares are expected to price at a prospective price to earnings (P.E.) multiple of 6.6 to 8.8 times, they said.
Nomura International is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on December 23, the market sources said.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares issued by China incorporated companies.

Sources said Shangdong Xinhua is expected to use HK$135 million of the proceeds to upgrade and expand production capacity and about HK$60 million to develop new products. The balance would be used to repay debt and for working capital.
Shangdong Xinhua posted profit after tax of 41.5 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1995, against 41.3 million yuan in 1994 and 45.4 million yuan in 1993, market sources said.
It posted profit of 44.4 million yuan for the six months to June 30, 1996, they said.
Shangdong Xinhua is expected to be the last Chinese enterprise to seek an H-share listing in Hong Kong in 1996.
